review.why: Uses Cloudflare's cf CLI: install and sign in, search commands, preview with dry runs, deploy Workers and manage DNS, D1, KV and R2.
review.summary: Describes the beta cf CLI for the whole Cloudflare API and Workers projects. It says to search for commands, inspect the schema and preview with a dry run before running anything unverified, gives install and sign-in steps including headless login and an API token for CI, and explains when to use Wrangler instead. A docs table covers migration and agent safety rules.
strengths: Search, inspect, dry-run workflow for a very large command surface
Handles SSH and CI sign-in cases
Clear rule for choosing between cf and Wrangler
cautions: Tool is in beta, so commands can change
Commands can create and delete real resources
Later sections were not read in full
